entities.name: Gahiji, Honored One
entities.description: A figure who can stir the gentlest spirit to wild ferocity.

entities.name: Mayael the Anima
entities.description: The sacred Anima, whose eyes are blind to all but the grandest truths.

entities.name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
entities.description: A lich king who suffered a brutal death and unnatural rebirth, possibly by his own plan.

entities.name: Roon of the Hidden Realm
entities.description: A figure who regards time and space as battlefields to be mastered.

entities.name: Rubinia Soulsinger
entities.description: A figure who speaks of taking up the quill and feeling the future flow into runes.

entities.name: Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper
entities.description: A figure the orcs believe still lives in the Karplusan Mountains gathering a dead army for revenge.

entities.name: Karplusan Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where the orcs believe Sek'Kuar still lives.

entities.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
entities.description: A hegemon whose audience requires bringing a riddle she has not heard.

entities.name: Thraximundar
entities.description: A figure whose name means "he who paints the earth red."

events.summary: Nekusar, the lich king, died brutally and was unnaturally reborn, leaving his enemies to wonder if it was his plan.
events.quote: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

events.summary: Sek'Kuar is believed by the orcs to be gathering his dead army in the Karplusan Mountains, intent on revenge.
events.quote: The orcs believe Sek'Kuar still lives in the Karplusan Mountains, gathering his dead army, intent on revenge.

relations.note: Believed by the orcs to still live there.
relations.quote: The orcs believe Sek'Kuar still lives in the Karplusan Mountains
